subject: Procurement path & budget owner mapping - Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-22T15:02:00Z
Subject: Follow-up: procurement path & budget owner mapping

Hi Sam — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can map the commercial path and the internal approvers at Acme:

Recap from call:
- Acme intends to pilot Redwood for customer-facing retrieval/assistant use cases (expected monthly usage est. 2M tokens).
- Target go-live for pilot: April 2026.

Procurement / commercial questions:
1) Preferred purchase mechanism: PO (net 30) vs corporate card vs marketplace (AWS/GCP marketplace)?
2) Is there an internal procurement form we should complete? If so, please share the PDF or steps.
3) Who is the budget owner / economic buyer for this pilot? Who signs the PO/contract (name + title)?
4) Any finance sponsor or cost center we should reference on invoices?

Attachments: Redwood_Terms_Summary.pdf (summary of commercial terms)

Proposed next steps:
- If PO is preferred, we can send vendor details + sample SOW for signature.
- If marketplace is preferred, we can provide the listing details and a quick integration checklist.

Can you confirm the procurement route and loop in the relevant procurement/finance contact? Happy to join a short call with procurement if helpful.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: Redwood_Terms_Summary.pdf (1 page summary)

From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T18:45:00Z
Subject: RE: Follow-up: procurement path & budget owner mapping

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and for the doc. Short answers below:

- Preferred procurement method: For pilot/value < $50k we typically use card or P-card, but for anything that looks like multi-month SaaS or > $50k we route via PO (net 30). Given your pricing, PO is likely.
- Procurement form: attaching our standard procurement form (Acme_Procurement_Form.pdf). It requests vendor W9, address, contact info, and signatory name.
- Budget owner / economic buyer: Myself (Sam Turner, Head of Product Delivery) is sponsoring the pilot, but the finance sponsor is Priya Singh (Sr. Manager, Finance). Final signatory for contracts >$50k will be our CFO, Rajesh Patel.
- Marketplace: We're open to marketplace but prefer direct PO for pilots as it keeps procurement reporting simpler. We may consider marketplace for a later expansion.

Looping in Priya on next steps. Priya, can you confirm preferred invoice routing and any vendor setup requirements?

Thanks,
Sam
Senior Director, Product Delivery
Acme Corp
sam.turner@acme.com

Subject: RE: Follow-up: procurement path & budget owner mapping

Hi Priya / Sam — thanks for the quick clarification, that helps a lot. A proposed mapping and next steps below:

Mapping:
- Economic buyer / sponsor: Sam Turner (Head of Product Delivery)
- Finance sponsor / invoice routing: Priya Singh (Sr. Manager, Finance)
- Contract signatory for deals >$50k: Rajesh Patel (CFO)

Requested items from Acme (what we'll need to kick off vendor setup and PO):
- Completed procurement form (Acme_Procurement_Form.pdf) with vendor details
- W9 or vendor tax docs (US)
- Vendor contact for invoicing and purchase order acceptance
- Preferred PO template and any required PO fields (cost center, SOW ref)

Action items / timeline:
1) Priya / Procurement: please confirm any vendor setup timelines and share the completed procurement form. (Priya: can you also confirm if net-30 is standard or if your AP team needs specific SLAs?)
2) Marissa / Redwood: we will return vendor W9 and our vendor address + Redwood_Terms_Summary.pdf. We'll also attach a short sample SOW for the pilot for your review (SOW-draft.docx).
3) Schedule: if procurement completes vendor setup this week we can have a PO in place by the end of next week and kickoff the pilot in early April.

I can join a short call with procurement to walk through the SOW and billing fields if helpful. Vivek (cc) will handle any pricing exceptions; David (cc) will own the SOW/technical appendix.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: SOW-draft.docx

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement path & budget owner mapping

Hi all — looped in procurement mailbox and attaching our PO instructions. A few notes:

- Attached: Acme_PO_Instructions.pdf (includes vendor setup requirement and expected fields on PO).
- Vendor onboarding typically takes 3-5 business days once we have the completed procurement form + W9.
- Net 30 is standard for SaaS PO.
- For signatory: for pilot orders under $100k we can often execute with the Head of Product (Sam) plus finance approval; anything over $100k will require CFO sign-off.

Next steps from Acme side:
1) Marissa: please send vendor W9 and vendor address + Redwood legal contact (for PO/contract signature).
2) We'll return a completed vendor setup packet and confirm PO template fields.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Singh
Sr. Manager, Finance
Acme Corp
